definitions.short: properly, chastisement ; figuratively, reproof , warning or instruction ; also restraint
definitions.usage: bond, chastening(-eth), chastisement, check, correction, discipline, doctrine, instruction, rebuke.

occurrences.englishText: Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, his outstretched arm,
“Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects.
He loosens the bond of kings.
I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame.
He also opens their ears to instruction,
since you hate instruction,
to know wisdom and instruction;
to receive instruction in wise dealing,
The fear of Yahweh* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. is the beginning of knowledge;
My son, listen to your father’s instruction,
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline,
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction.
Take firm hold of instruction.
and say, “How I have hated instruction,
He will die for lack of instruction.
For the commandment is a lamp,
He followed her immediately,
Receive my instruction rather than silver,
Hear instruction, and be wise.
He is in the way of life who heeds correction,
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge,
A wise son listens to his father’s instruction,
Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline,
One who spares the rod hates his son,
A fool despises his father’s correction,
There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way:
He who refuses correction despises his own soul,
The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom.
Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it,
Listen to counsel and receive instruction,
If you stop listening to instruction, my son,
Folly is bound up in the heart of a child:
Apply your heart to instruction,
Don’t withhold correction from a child.
Buy the truth, and don’t sell it.
Then I saw, and considered well.
Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you.
But he was pierced for our transgressions.
“I have struck your children in vain.

O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.
You shall tell them, ‘This is the nation that has not listened to Yahweh their God’s voice, nor received instruction. Truth has perished, and is cut off from their mouth.’
But they are together brutish and foolish,
But they didn’t listen. They didn’t turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.
All your lovers have forgotten you.
They have turned their backs to me, and not their faces. Although I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.
“Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words?” says Yahweh.

So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—
The rebels are deep in slaughter;
She didn’t obey the voice. She didn’t receive correction. She didn’t trust in Yahweh. She didn’t draw near to her God.
I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her.” But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
